title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience-sourced recording of a classic show with tight first set, standout Tennessee Jed, Playin' in the Band and Crazy Fingers
ai_review.review: The audience tape captures the concert with impressive clarity—music sits front‑and‑center while crowd noise stays low enough to stay unobtrusive. Fans rave about a very tight first set and a second half highlighted by a superb Tennessee Jed, an inspired Playin' in the Band and a fiery Crazy Fingers, making it one of the year's best performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (tight set, standout songs) and recording clarity, indicating an exceptional show with excellent audience source quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good audience tape; music is very present with low, acceptable crowd level. Review mentions excellent sounding soundboard and audience mix, yielding clear and balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as fantastic and very tight; second set features a nicely flowing Playin' into Crazy Fingers, maintaining strong momentum throughout.
